record.original_question: Fix k >= 2. Does there exist m_0 such that whenever m >= m_0 and G is F_{k,3}-free, then for each residue class l with 1 <= l <= k - 1 and m + k(k+1)/2 == l mod k, the graph G satisfies lambda(G) <= lambda(S^{1,l}_{(m-l)/k + (k+3)/2, k}), with equality only for that extremal graph?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3.40. Let k >= 2. There is an m0 such that for all m >= m0, and for all G in G(m, Fk,3). If m + k(k+1)/2 == l (mod k) with 1 <= l <= k - 1, then lambda(G) <= lambda(S^{1,l}_{(m-l)/k + (k+3)/2, k}). Equality holds if and only if G ~= S^{1,l}_{(m-l)/k + (k+3)/2, k}.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup and notation.

- For an integer k ≥ 2, the friendship graph F_{k,3} is the graph obtained from k triangles by identifying exactly one common vertex (so |V(F_{k,3})| = 2k+1 and |E(F_{k,3})| = 3k).
- For a graph H, a graph G is called H-free if it contains no subgraph isomorphic to H.
- Given a positive integer m and a graph H, let G(m, H) denote the family of all H-free graphs with exactly m edges and no isolated vertices.
- For a graph G, let λ(G) denote the largest eigenvalue (spectral radius) of its adjacency matrix.
- Disjoint union of graphs is denoted by ∪, and the join of two graphs A and B (the disjoint union together with all edges between V(A) and V(B)) is denoted A ∨ B. Let K_t denote the complete graph on t vertices and tK_1 the empty graph on t vertices.
- For integers n, k with k ≥ 2 and 0 ≤ l ≤ k, define
   S^{1,l}_{n,k} := K_l ∨ ( ( K_{k−l} ∨ (n − k − 1)K_1 ) ∪ K_1 ).
  (So S^{1,l}_{n,k} has n vertices.)

Question. Fix k ≥ 2. Does there exist an integer m_0 = m_0(k) with the following property: for every m ≥ m_0 and every G ∈ G(m, F_{k,3}), if l is the unique integer with 1 ≤ l ≤ k − 1 such that
   m + k(k+1)/2 ≡ l (mod k),
then
   λ(G) ≤ λ( S^{1,l}_{ (m−l)/k + (k+3)/2 , k } ),
with equality if and only if G is isomorphic to S^{1,l}_{ (m−l)/k + (k+3)/2 , k }?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as a conjecture in a recent survey on edge-spectral-Turán problems. Related results have established the spectral extremal F_{k,3}-free bound in some residue classes (notably the case treated by Li–Lu–Peng and the confirmation for general k under a divisibility/edge-count hypothesis), but the full congruence-refined statement covering all residue classes 1 ≤ l ≤ k−1 with the extremal graph S^{1,l}_{n,k} appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Spectral Extrema of Graphs With Fixed Size: Forbidden a Fan Graph, a Friendship Graph, or a Theta Graph
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes spectral extremal results for F_{k,3}-free graphs of fixed size m and confirms a conjecture of Li, Lu, and Peng in a particular regime.
status_evidence.claim: Partial spectral extremal results for F_{k,3}-free graphs are known, but the residue-class refinement of the conjecture is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: Spectral extremal graphs for the bowtie
status_evidence.snippet: Treats the case k=2 (bowtie) of F_{k,3}-free spectral extremal problems.
status_evidence.claim: The k=2 case has been solved; the conjecture concerns all k ≥ 2 with congruence refinement.
